entry.name: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
entry.note: From backprop by hand to a working GPT, on video, building everything live
entry.audience: Engineers who want to build GPT from scratch

covers: Manual backpropagation through a two-layer MLP
reading.format: Video lectures with code implementations built from scratch.
reading.summary: This course teaches how to build neural networks from scratch in code. It starts with backpropagation and progresses to modern deep neural networks such as GPT. The course focuses on language models as a way to learn deep learning, with skills that transfer to other areas like computer vision.
reading.audience: People who want to learn deep learning, including those who may later work in areas such as computer vision.
reading.prerequisites: Solid programming in Python and introductory math such as derivatives and Gaussian distributions.
